description: Fork of exp064 (raw V into SDPA, no V dominance). Single change: d_v 16 -> 32. V LUT n_outputs doubles (per-layer V weights +3.15M, total +18.87M = 148.18M params). out_proj input_dim 96 -> 192 (anchors only; weights unchanged). Q/K unchanged (d_qk still 32). Hypothesis: with V no longer expanded into dominance space, doubling d_v gives SDPA 2x value-information per token to mix.
